parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

items.question: Library. Please help staff by returning all books, films, etc. to the correct shelf.
options: You need to give everything you have borrowed back to the library now.
You must ask the staff if you are not sure where to find something.
You should put things back in the right place when you finish.

items.question: Marta – Why weren't you at school today? Mrs Ross talked about the trip. I offered to take your letter, but she'll send it. Diana
options: Marta must tell the teacher if she wants to go on the trip.
Marta will get a letter about the trip in the post.
Diana has got a letter for Marta about the trip.

items.question: SCHOOL SHOP. Don't miss our end of year sale. 50% discount on all books.
options: Books are cheaper now.
The sale is nearly finished.
The shop is going to close.

items.question:
ART CLUB starts at 4 p.m. on Monday.
Try a different art activity each week until the end of term. Interested? Tell Mr Thomas before Friday.
The notice tells students
options: what to do if they want to join the club.
what type of art they will be doing at the club.
what time the club finishes each week.

items.question:
Lucia – I've just found your dictionary in my bag. I forgot to give it back to you after I borrowed it today. Sorry! Carlos
Carlos is telling Lucia that
options: he forgot to lend her something.
he has something which belongs to her.
he has lost something which she gave him.

items.question:
SCHOOL CONCERT
Friday at 8 p.m. Hurry – there are a few tickets left. £2 each.
The notice tells students that
options: the tickets are cheaper now.
they mustn't be late for the concert.
tickets for the concert are still available.

parts.title: Listening Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.
parts.formTitle: Leonardo Da Vinci School of Art and Drama

rows.label: Type of shoes for afternoon classes:

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: Welcome to your first day at the Leonardo Da Vinci School of Art and Drama.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: I'm Maria Muzzio – your teacher this year. However, despite my name, I am not Italian. I am actually <u>British</u>.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: Please listen carefully to this information. You must all be in your classroom at nine o'clock every morning. I'll check your names and then <u>the first class begins at quarter past nine</u>.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: If you can't come to school because you're ill, for example, your parents should call me as soon as they can <u>on seven-double eight-five-four-two-one</u>.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: When you come back to school you'll have to do any work you missed.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: In the mornings, you'll all be together for <u>English, maths and science</u>.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: In the afternoon, students on the Art programme will do art and music, while those on the Theatre programme have dance and drama.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: <u>For afternoon classes, make sure you wear trainers</u>. You can't dance in boots, or paint in sandals!

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: And finally, we have school sweaters for sale. The normal price is twelve pounds fifty but <u>they're only nine pounds seventy-five</u> for first year students.

parts.title: Reading & Writing Part 6
parts.instructions:
Read the email from your English friend, Lucy. Write an email to Lucy and answer the questions.
Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
From: Lucy

I'm so happy. I finished all my exams yesterday. What is your school like? What subjects do you like best? Who is your favourite teacher?

Write an email to Lucy and answer the questions.

checklist.band5: All three questions are answered clearly and with relevant detail.
checklist.band3: Two questions answered, or answers lack detail.
checklist.band1: Only one question answered or content is mostly irrelevant.

checklist.band5: The email is well-organised with a greeting, clear answers and a sign-off.
checklist.band3: Some organisation but may lack greeting/sign-off or answers are not clearly separated.
checklist.band1: Very little organisation. Hard to follow.

checklist.band5: Uses a range of everyday vocabulary and grammar accurately. Spelling is mostly correct.
checklist.band3: Uses simple vocabulary and grammar with some errors that don't prevent understanding.
checklist.band1: Very limited vocabulary. Frequent errors make the text difficult to understand.

parts.sampleAnswer:
Hi Lucy,
My school is very large and modern, with computers in most classrooms. My favourite subjects are maths and science. I think my maths teacher is amazing.
Bye for now.

items.question:
Passengers should stay in their seats until the bus stops.
Driver may stop suddenly.
options: Passengers should never ask the driver to stop.
Passengers should not stand up before the bus stops.
Passengers should stand up when their bus stop is near.

items.question:
MUSIC MAKERS
Please check your change carefully before you leave the shop.
options: If customers buy the wrong thing, they can bring it back.
Customers should look at the money they get back after paying.
Customers need to be careful while they are in the shop.

items.question:
Want guitar lessons but don't have a guitar?
Two available to borrow – see Mr Titchmarsh
Go and speak to Mr Titchmarsh if you want to
options: use a guitar.
book a guitar teacher.
learn about different guitars.

items.question:
From: Lars
Hans, I think we'll need to leave for the airport 30 minutes earlier than we agreed – my mum says the traffic's terrible on Fridays.
What is Lars telling Hans?
options: His mother will take them to the airport.
They should use a different type of transport.
Getting to the airport will take longer than they thought.

items.question:
Students' room
Use the sitting area for chatting,
not the study area.
options: You must not use the sitting area for studying.
You must leave the students' room to talk.
You must be quiet in the study area.

items.question:
To: Class 8
From: Ms Tucker
Subject: Castle trip
You don't need to wear uniform, but there'll be a long walk, so shoes must be comfortable.
Ms Tucker wants the students to
options: decide if they want to go walking.
wear shoes that are good for walking.
take uniforms to put on after a walk.

parts.title: Listening Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: OK, listen everyone. I want to tell you about some after-school music lessons.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: The teacher is <u>Mrs Clarke</u>. She's been teaching music here for five years.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: She teaches <u>guitar</u>. She can also play the piano and violin, but she only teaches guitar.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: The lessons are on <u>Wednesdays</u>, after school. They used to be on Thursdays, but Mrs Clarke changed the day.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: They're in <u>room 58</u>. That's the music room on the second floor, not room 68 which is on the third floor.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: You'll need to buy a book called <u>Improve</u>. You can get it from any music shop or online.

script.speaker: Teacher
script.text: The lessons cost <u>twenty-three pounds twenty</u> per month. That's very good for weekly lessons.

At school we listen to pop music in our music lessons. I would like to learn the guitar because I love rock music. At home, I usually listen to music on my phone in my bedroom.
